svg.title: ForgeOps architecture
svg.desc: GitHub webhooks and API clients reach the control plane, visitors reach the router. The control plane, executor and router coordinate only through Redis; builds run in gVisor sandboxes and apps run as tenant containers.
svg.text: Three processes, one repo, coordinated through Redis
no host FS · no internal net · caps

text.tspan: build queue · deploy status · router registry · log pub/sub · :6380

svg.text: Target architecture. Today (Phase 0) the three services boot, connect to Postgres and Redis, and pass health checks.
